reviewer.role: Independent AI technical reviewer; separate from frontend author
reviewer.scope: Independent code, DOM and focused real-Chromium behavior review. This is not an external Claude review and not a release authorization.

resolvedFindings.problem: A SecurityError from the localStorage getter silently selected a memory-only cache while manual submission said the answer was saved. A reload would lose that answer without warning.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The frontend author added a persistent warning when durable storage is unavailable and durability-aware manual feedback. The reviewer reproduced the corrected behavior and the runtime gate now includes both the getter-error and quota cases.

resolvedFindings.problem: An actual two-tab Chromium reproduction showed a queued help-restoration toggle writing an unchanged stale snapshot over the other tab’s newer draft before storage events arrived. The first tab froze and the stale second tab remained editable.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The author added a byte-identical-state no-op guard after the latest-versus-expected conflict check. The independent reviewer then passed 30 instrumented Chromium reproduction cycles; unchanged restored help and unchanged manual submissions are also covered by the reviewer DOM regression.

checks.name: independent initial/step/case/nested theory DOM review
assertions: Every fresh card starts on neutral view with zero revealed steps.
Every authored step appends without removing prior steps.
Only case views whose unlock step has been reached are visible.
Actual selected view matches the authored step view.
Nested theory12→theory1→back restores selected step4, open explanation, task answer, original task SVG and return focus.
Restored help and an unchanged manual submission perform no Storage.setItem call.

checks.name: independent instrumented real-browser two-tab race stress
checks.scenario: Restore two revealed steps and open help, open a second tab, then edit the first tab immediately; the older second tab freezes. Instrumented Storage.setItem distinguishes no-op writes from changed writes.

checks.name: independent real-browser responsive and scene-return repeatability
assertions: Every initial and final scene renders from a recursively frozen model.
Resizing changes no SVG geometry primitive or input model data.
Returning to 320 px exactly restores label coordinates, text anchor, font size and placement classification.
Returning through neutral to the chosen scene exactly restores the prior rendering.
No unresolved label placement in these inspected scenes.

checks.name: independent final full-browser evidence audit
assertions: The full expected view × card × width matrix contains no missing, extra or duplicate entry.
The 692 initial/final screenshot files exist and cover every card at both widths.
Every complete step journey includes all authored steps and opened explanations without document overflow.
The recorded bundle, authored content and implementation hashes match the frozen candidate.
The two-tab diagnostics show the newer first-tab draft retained and the stale second-tab input frozen.
checks.scopeLimitation: This is a hash-bound cloud-development run with head=null, not an exact-Git-head CI or publication verdict.

codeInspection: Public entry point never enables allowInReview; unavailable cards are withheld from the public catalog.
The renderer consumes only the active scene, does not accumulate other cases, and uses plain arcs unless equality ticks are explicitly specified.
Label placement reads only current-scene SVG lines, markers, circles and visible points. It changes text positions and anchors without mutating model coordinates or geometry primitives.

Clean authored label positions stay fixed. Remaining candidates are ranked deterministically by authored displacement, bounded radial distance and preference for outside positions; proximity to another named point is rejected.

The bounded search reports unresolved labels explicitly. The browser gate rejects unresolved labels, edge/marker crossings, overlap, clipping, small text, unexpected labels and document overflow rather than accepting a partial placement.
ResizeObserver redraws the current scene using the same algorithm with the current rendered font size. No hidden future scene data affects placement.
The no-op storage guard runs after the stale-save check, retains persistent-save feedback and prevents queued disclosure restoration from writing unchanged snapshots.
Source page mapping uses the 2023 edition offset of 1.
All student text is appended as text through the formatter, not injected as HTML.
Manual proof saving does not claim mathematical correctness.
Known newer saves from another tab freeze stale input and retain a copy before recovery.
Theory popup and task views retain separate geometry state; restored theory unlock progress is passed to the renderer.
Responsive CSS stacks lesson/help at narrow widths. The separate final complete browser evidence passed against the frozen implementation and authored-content hashes.

advisoryFindings.recommendation: Omit links from a theory card to itself while retaining the explanation text and source reference. Cross-theory links should remain.
advisoryFindings.resolution: The builder excludes the current theory id from generated theory references; the frozen candidate contains no self-theory links.

notRun: Independent manual visual inspection of every scene and viewport by this frontend reviewer. Separate visual reviewers cover initial/final images.
Exact-Git-head CI and production deployment verification.
limitations: JSDOM proves event/state behavior, not real font geometry, clipping, layout or native fullscreen behavior.

The earlier full run exposed label collisions and the reproduced two-tab race. Those historical failures are resolved by the current changes and verified by the completed final 1690-view run; exact-head CI, visual review and release approval remain separate evidence.

localStorage is not a transactional collaborative store. The guard prevents the reproduced stale no-op overwrite and the app freezes known stale saves; truly simultaneous independent edits are not server-synchronized.
Any material edit to a reviewed file invalidates its hash-bound finding until reviewed again.
